mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 inducer that may reduce pioglitazone plasma concentrations, potentially diminishing efficacy; pioglitazone may also affect cenobamate metabolism through CYP450 interactions.
action: Monitor glycemic control closely; pioglitazone dose adjustment may be necessary; consider alternative antiepileptic if feasible or increase monitoring frequency.
